name: rules-ontology
what: Sign-ins, the Ontology view with the sign-in file (auth) opened: its three rules set on columns, each in words with what a broken row does (Method one of its five values, else the day holds; Latency 0 to 30,000 ms and Country never blank, else the row is flagged), each with Change and Remove for the owner, and an Add a rule button on every column's card; a note that the file's meanings and rules are shared (examples/ontologies/auth.json), with its download

text: Method is Password, Single sign-on, MFA push, Passkey or API key: else hold the day
Latency is from 0 to 30,000 ms: else flag the row and keep it
Country is never blank: else flag the row and keep it
Shared. auth’s meanings and rules come from ../ontologies/auth.json, which every flow that reads auth imports
noText: Not checked: switched off in auth_valid’s cell

name: rules-add-form
what: The owner taps Add a rule on the User card: the form in place of the button, what User must be (never blank by default), what a row that breaks it does, Add the rule and Cancel

pageText: For auth only. On once saved

name: rules-added
what: The rule added: User is never blank, else flag the row and keep it, listed on the User card and among the changes above the files; the check cell auth_valid gains user_required: 'on' in its ontology list

pageText: User is never blank: else flag the row and keep it
Added a rule to auth: User is never blank, else flag the row and keep it

name: rules-tab
what: The sign-in file's import card, Rules tab: its four rules, each with a switch (on), what a broken row does, and what the run on screen counted

text: Method is Password, Single sign-on, MFA push, Passkey or API key

name: rules-switched-off
what: Latency's rule switched off on the import card: struck through, Off, not enforced, written into the check cell auth_valid (its ontology list), recorded as a flow change

expect.status: Switched off a rule of auth

name: rules-reload
what: After a reload, the rules as edited: four, Latency's off

name: rules-ontology-off
what: The Ontology view says Latency's rule is switched off in auth_valid's cell

text: Not checked: switched off in auth_valid’s cell

name: rules-tab-dark
what: The Rules tab in dark, in a fresh browser: the three rules the flow ships with
